readings: For each film rating, compute the ratio as the average over that rating's films of each film's own rental_rate divided by its replacement_cost (the mean of per-film ratios). Show the rating, that ratio, the number of films in the rating, and the rating's ratio minus the plain average of the five ratings' ratios. Don't round.

For each film rating, compute the ratio as the average rental_rate of that rating's films divided by the average replacement_cost of the same films (the ratio of the two averages, which equals total rental_rate over total replacement_cost). Show the rating, that ratio, the number of films in the rating, and the rating's ratio minus the plain average of the five ratings' ratios. Don't round.
queries:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / replacement_cost) AS ratio, COUNT(*) AS film_count
  FROM film
  GROUP BY rating
)
SELECT rating, ratio, film_count, ratio - (SELECT AVG(ratio) FROM r) AS diff_from_avg
FROM r;
WITH r AS (
  SELECT rating,
         AVG(rental_rate) / AVG(replacement_cost) AS ratio,
         COUNT(*) AS film_count
  FROM film
  GROUP BY rating
)
SELECT rating,
       ratio,
       film_count,
       ratio - (SELECT AVG(ratio) FROM r) AS diff_from_avg
FROM r;
